title: Shaidun da Suka Dage
intro: Ka yi tunanin lokacin da aka gwada imani da wuta, kuma imani mara misaltuwa ya zama babban rashin amincewa. An ba ka aikin gano asalin wata ƙungiya wadda aka ba da labarinta a cikin Alƙur'ani, labarin imani mai zurfi game da zalunci mai tsanani. Bayyana alamun don gano su wanene waɗannan rayuka, da kuma yanayin da suka fuskanta na ban mamaki.
clues: Mun tsaya tsayin daka a kan yakininmu, duk da matsin lamba mai yawa na yin watsi da imaninmu.
Mun fuskanci wani babban mai mulki wanda ya nemi ya kashe hasken tauhidi.
Mun shaida manyan alamu da mu'ujizai, duk da haka masu zaluntarmu sun kasance ba su kula ba.
Mun jure wata mummunar hanya ta tsanantawa da aka tsara don tsoratar da wasu su miƙa wuya.
An jefa mu cikin wata mummunar wuta, duk da haka dagewarmu ta samar mana da matsayi mai girma a wurin Allah.
An ba da labarinmu a cikin Sura mai suna bayan taurarin sama, tana gargaɗi game da makomar waɗanda ke tsananta wa muminai.

trial.label: Tsanantawarmu
options: Iska mai zafi ta cinye shi
A jefa shi cikin rami mai wuta
trial.answer: A jefa shi cikin rami mai wuta

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: Wata rami mai zurfi mai ƙonewa
location.answer: Wata rami mai zurfi mai ƙonewa

outcome.label: Makomarmu ta Ƙarshe
options: An ba su mulki a duniya.
An ceto su ta hanyar tserewa mai ban mamaki.
Sun sami shahada da lada mai ɗorewa.
An canza su zuwa wani nau'in halitta daban.
An ba su dukiya da wadata mai yawa.
outcome.answer: Sun sami shahada da lada mai ɗorewa.

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
